name: Wine (White)
siboNotes: Alcohol can slow gastric emptying and may worsen SIBO symptoms in some individuals. Consume in moderation and monitor tolerance.
preparationTips: Choose dry white wines over sweet varieties to avoid added sugars
Consume with food to slow alcohol absorption
Stay hydrated by drinking water alongside wine
Limit to 1-2 glasses to avoid digestive irritation
pairsWellWith: Low FODMAP herbs like basil or oregano
nutritionalHighlights: May support heart health in moderation
